events.label: truck_crash_ragdoll
events.what: The mail truck swerves off the mountain road and crashes into bushes, flinging the driver.

events.label: finish_line_crash
events.what: The mail truck flies towards the finish line at high speed and crashes straight into the finish barrier.

events.label: high_speed_explosion
events.what: The truck slams into a roadside wall at full speed and explodes, launching the driver into the air.

events.label: successful_fast_delivery
events.what: The player executes a fast boost run through the postal level and jumps to complete the delivery in gold time.

events.label: mountain_wall_crash
events.what: The vehicle fails to make a sharp turn on the cliff road and explodes on impact with the rock wall.

events.label: cliff_shortcut_finish
events.what: The mail truck launches off a hillside shortcut, lands back on the highway, and speeds across the finish line.

events.label: wild_offroad_finish
events.what: The truck tumbles off the road and rolls down a steep forest hill, barely crossing the finish line down below.

events.label: gold_run_completion
events.what: The player navigates the forest turns at full speed and leaps across the finish banner for a gold medal run.

events.label: unexpected_street_explosion
events.what: The mail truck abruptly detonates on the city street while the player is alt-tabbed in the menu.
